rules.title: ScootRadar cache target down
rules.summary: Prometheus cannot scrape the scooter feed cache.
rules.description: The cache's /metrics on scootradar-cache:3001 has been down or missing for 3 minutes. The map keeps answering only while the container runs: check the Coolify application mouc13tsnvylg0v9ee9wp5v5 and https://scooter-data.plhery.com/health.

rules.title: ScootRadar serves no scooters
rules.description: The map shows no scooters anywhere and /ready answers 503. Look at the snapshot_feed_failed lines in Loki ({app="scootradar-cache"}): the network, or every operator at once.

rules.title: ScootRadar collector stalled
rules.summary: No feed collection has finished for 5 minutes.
rules.description: Every collection, successful or not, updates the snapshot. Swiss feeds are collected every minute and the others at staggered times, every 20 minutes or every minute while watched, so one finishes every few seconds. The scheduler is stuck: restart the cache (Coolify application mouc13tsnvylg0v9ee9wp5v5) and report what the logs say.

rules.title: ScootRadar feed stopped
rules.expr: (max by (feed, source, provider) (scootradar_feed_state{job="scootradar-cache", state="expired", feed!="national:voiscooters.com"}) or max by (feed, source, provider) (min_over_time(scootradar_feed_state{job="scootradar-cache", state="expired", feed="national:voiscooters.com"}[5m]))) unless on (feed) (max by (feed) (scootradar_feed_paused{job="scootradar-cache"}) == 1) unless on (feed) (max by (feed) (max_over_time(scootradar_feed_curfewed{job="scootradar-cache"}[20m])) == 1) and on (feed) (avg_over_time((clamp_max(max by (feed) (scootradar_feed_state{job="scootradar-cache", state=~"ok|failing"}) + on (feed) max by (feed) (scootradar_feed_paused{job="scootradar-cache"}), 1) or max by (feed) (scootradar_feed_state{job="scootradar-cache", state=~"ok|failing"}))[7d:5m]) > 0.5)
rules.summary: {{ $labels.feed }} has been expired for 10 minutes (Voi Switzerland for 15).
rules.description: Expired: a feed nobody looks at has had no successful collection for 30 minutes (its 20-minute interval and ten), or a Swiss feed, or one watched for 15 minutes, has positions over 15 minutes old. The map says {{ $labels.provider }} is not sharing data where this feed covers, or would as soon as someone looked. It was served more than half of the last 7 days; dead feeds, and feeds such as Velospot that are fresh only now and then, are not reported (see the dashboard's "Expired, rarely served"). A feed in its seasonal pause (scootradar_feed_paused, as Montréal each winter) is not reported, and its days in the pause count as served, so one that does not come back after its season is. Voi Switzerland (national:voiscooters.com), whose feed runs 2 or 3 minutes short of expiring and which Voi stalls upstream for up to 21 minutes, is reported once expired for 15 minutes, as Sentry does. Nor is a feed under a night ban at all its service areas (scootradar_feed_curfewed, as Trondheim on Friday and Saturday nights, when Dott takes its feed down) until it is still expired 30 minutes after the ban, as Sentry waits: the curfew holds the feed out for 20 minutes after the ban, then the rule's 10. The Sentry issue for the feed in scootradar-cache gives its last error, or says its data aged past the limit without one. Loki: {app="scootradar-cache", event="snapshot_feed_state"} | json | feed="{{ $labels.feed }}".

rules.title: ScootRadar feed empty
rules.expr: (max by (feed, source, provider) (max_over_time(scootradar_feed_vehicles{job="scootradar-cache"}[3d])) < bool 1 and on (feed) max by (feed) (scootradar_feed_vehicles{job="scootradar-cache"}) and on (feed) max by (feed) (max_over_time(scootradar_feed_vehicles{job="scootradar-cache"}[1h] offset 3d)) unless on (feed) (max by (feed) (max_over_time(scootradar_feed_paused{job="scootradar-cache"}[3d])) == 1) unless on (feed) (avg_over_time((max by (feed) (scootradar_feed_state{job="scootradar-cache", state="expired"}))[1d:5m]) > 0.5)) * on (feed) group_left (country) max by (feed, country) (scootradar_feed_info{job="scootradar-cache"})
rules.summary: {{ $labels.provider }} feed {{ $labels.feed }} in {{ $labels.country }} has listed no available scooter for 3 days.
rules.description: The feed answers but has listed no available standing scooter for 3 days, outside any seasonal pause: the map shows none of its scooters. A quiet night or a snow day does not last that long. The operator may have left the town, taken its scooters in for a season the catalog does not know, or its feed may be broken while still answering. Check the operator's site or app and the town's own pages, then: add a `seasonal` window to the catalog if the city or the operator publishes one; remove the feed and record it in docs/coverage-gaps.md if the scooters are gone; or silence the feed in Grafana while waiting. A catalog feed whose operator lists nothing at all (Bird's town with no scooter and no time, a Dott region it has paused) counts as empty; a Swiss system sharedmobility.ch lists after its operator stopped does not. Feeds followed for under 3 days, paused at any time in the last 3, or expired over half of the last day (the feed-stopped alert's) are not reported. Reminded once a day while it lasts. Its counts: scootradar_feed_vehicles{feed="{{ $labels.feed }}"} in Prometheus.

rules.title: ScootRadar feed discovery stale
rules.summary: The feed catalog has not been discovered for 2 hours.
rules.description: Discovery runs hourly and retries every minute on failure; the cache keeps its previous catalog meanwhile, so new systems are missing and retired ones stay. The Sentry discovery issue in scootradar-cache has the error.

rules.title: ScootRadar cache restarting
rules.summary: One build of the cache has restarted more than three times in an hour.
rules.description: A deploy starts another build and is not counted. Restarts of one build are a crash loop: out of heap, killed above its 2048 MiB, or a startup failure. Its last logs are in Loki ({app="scootradar-cache"}) and an exception in Sentry's scootradar-cache project.

rules.title: ScootRadar cache memory high
rules.summary: The cache has used over 1.8 GB, or its V8 heap over 1 GB, for 15 minutes.
rules.description: The container is limited to 2048 MiB and is killed above it. Node gives the V8 heap 1072 MiB of that, and the heap runs out first (DEPLOY.md). A catalog that grew, or a leak: compare with the feed count on the dashboard.

rules.title: ScootRadar Geoapify near its daily limit
rules.summary: Address searches sent Geoapify over 2,400 requests in 24 hours.
rules.description: Geoapify's free plan allows 3,000 a day. Past it, searches fall back to komoot's public Photon, slower (geoapify_fallback in the Worker's logs). Look at the Worker's /api/geocode traffic in Cloudflare for a burst from one client; for growth, a paid plan or our own Photon (DEPLOY.md).
